This millet plot is very small, only a tiny piece of rented land, so I cannot spend much cash on it. Since I do not own it, I will not waste manure here — I keep my manure for my own fields. Millet is hardy and my family has always grown it with local seed saved from last harvest, so I will do the same. I have no irrigation here, we depend on the meher rains, and my wife and I can handle the weeding and harvest ourselves on such a small patch.
